observations: Opened assets/panels/05-3.png. Meera sits behind the desk at left facing screen-right and smiling warmly. Her face, braid, hoop earring and bangle all match main-cast.png.
Meera's right hand (bangle wrist, arm from her right side) is held open, palm up, toward Ravi's phone. Her left hand rests on the desk. This matches the record.
Ravi is seen from behind in the right foreground: back of his head, beard edge and green sleeve. He keeps Meera-left / Ravi-right from 05-1.

Ravi holds the phone in his left hand, which carries the wristwatch, with the screen turned outward. That matches heldBy ravi.left. The fingertips at the phone's right edge read as the same hand wrapping round, and his right hand is not visible, consistent with 'out of frame'.
The phone screen shows a calendar-icon card and a profile-icon card with grey bar placeholders. There is no readable text.

Continuity note, not blocking: the card set differs from 05-2 (calendar plus heart there), and the phone moves from his right hand in 05-1 to his left here. 05-2 has both hands on it, which bridges the change, and the record notes it.
On page-05.png the bubble fills the empty upper area with its tail down to Meera's head. It covers no face or hand.
